name: Belmond Savute Elephant Lodge
positioning: Belmond's Savute Elephant Lodge, a tented safari lodge in the heart of the Savute Channel in Chobe National Park, Botswana
best_for: Travelers who want an all-inclusive safari lodge in a remote part of Chobe
Families looking for a lodge with children's amenities and activities

facts.text: The lodge is located in a remote corner of Chobe desert.
The lodge is situated in the heart of the Savute Channel.
The lodge is a 50 minute flight from Maun.
The lodge is a 40 minute flight from Kasane.
The lodge has an airstrip and helipad.
The tented rooms are raised on a bamboo platform and have a four-poster bed.
Bush dining and sundowners are offered.
The lodge has a heated swimming pool.
The lodge offers children's amenities and activities.
A minimum of 2 game viewing activities per day is included.

highlights.text: The lodge has a lookout hide over a watering hole.
The Savute channel started flowing again in 2008 and goes from dry to wet unpredictably.
San Bushmen created paintings in the ancient rocks of the hills near the lodge over 2000 years ago.
Savute is the Setswana word for unpredictable.

considerations.text: The lodge is in a remote corner of Chobe desert and is reached by flight from Maun or Kasane.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires charter flights.
WhataHotel notes seasonal wildlife activity depends on migration patterns.

sources.title: Belmond Savute Elephant Lodge, Chobe National Park
